adjudication.rationale: `EmbeddingSerializer` declares `has_many :embeddable_hosts, ... embed: :ids` (app/serializers/embedding_serializer.rb:3) and the admin UI iterates `embedding.embeddable_hosts` (app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs). The store’s hydration logic (`_hydrateEmbedded` in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6) converts `embeddable_host_ids` into `embeddable_hosts` by looking up each id in a side-loaded root collection. With `embed: :ids` but no explicit inclusion (`include: true`/sideloading), the response may contain only the `*_ids` and omit the `embeddable_hosts` collection, leaving `_lookupSubType` nothing to resolve and the admin list empty.
